issue.title: Trim full-help parser registrar imports
issue.description: Deferred by epic bead sase-en in plans:202608/bead_show_speed.md; not caused by that epic. Narrow command dispatch now avoids unrelated registrars, but full parser construction for bare/help/completion paths still imports every registrar through parser_full_registrars. Fresh imports on the integrated tree average 194.9 ms for sase.main.parser_vcs and 121.4 ms for sase.main.parser_ace. Scope: make parser registration dependencies lightweight or lazy for full-help and completion paths while preserving byte-identical help, parser registry parity, and all command choices.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05 at master 0e40decdc. Each of these was re-verified as STILL REPRODUCING and is being closed as a deliberate deprioritization, not as fixed: sase-ed ('sase doctor -C project.bead_pages' still reports the same 5 misattributed commit links across sase-b5 and sase-b7 pages); sase-er (src/sase/main/bead_fast_path.py:9 still imports close_mutation_commit_message and mutation_commit_message at module scope); sase-es (src/sase/main/parser.py:461 still pulls COMMAND_REGISTRARS_BY_NAME from parser_full_registrars); sase-ev (crates/sase_core/src/bead/cli.rs:172 handle_show is still the dormant parity renderer); sase-ey (src/sase/bead/cli_detail.py still prints raw closed_at and src/sase/agents/cli_sync.py:152 still hardcodes a UTC strftime label); sase-f7 ('sase agent index verify -j' still ok=false with corrupt_rows=4, and missing_rows has grown from 2 to 77); sase-f9 ('sase bead doctor' still reports the same 14 malformed design refs, 14 sase-5l.* owner mismatches, 1 unresolvable artifact ref, and now 453 redundant close events). All scope and evidence stays readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.
